statement_en: Let $t(n)$ be the minimum number of points in $\{1,\ldots,n\}^2$ such that the $\binom{t}{2}$ lines determined by these points cover all points in $\{1,\ldots,n\}^2$. Estimate $t(n)$. In particular, is it true that $t(n)=o(n)$?
